blocks.passage:
A status update is a short report: what is done, what is in progress, and what is next.

Managers love clear updates. They do not need a long story — just the facts. "I have finished the report. I am working on the slides. Next, I will talk to the client."

Good updates save time and build trust. When your manager knows what you are doing, they stop asking — and you can focus on the work.

audio.text:
It's Monday morning, and I'm sending my manager a short update — three lines, three tasks. Let me read it as I write, so you hear how simple it should be.

I don't start with 'Hi, hope you had a good weekend, the weather was nice…' No. Managers are busy. I go straight to the facts.

Line one — what's done. 'The client report is finished and sent.' Good, that's off the list.

Line two — what's in progress. 'I'm working on the Friday slides now, about halfway.' So she knows where I am.

Line three — what's next. 'Next, I'll call the São Paulo supplier this afternoon.' Now she knows my plan.

That's it. Done, in progress, next. Three lines. She can read it in ten seconds, and now she doesn't need to ask me 'how's it going?' five times today. That's the point — a good update means fewer interruptions, more real work.

Short, factual, and every Monday. That builds trust fast.

items.q: A **status update** is…
options: a short report on what's done, in progress and next
items.why: Status update = atualização de status.

items.q: **In progress** means…
items.why: In progress = em andamento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The report is **___** — it's completely finished."
items.why: Done = feito, concluído.

items.q: "I've **just** finished it." Just here means…
items.why: Just = acabei de.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I haven't started the slides **___**."
items.why: Yet = ainda (com negativa).

items.q: "That's **off the list**." To be off the list means…
items.why: Off the list = já resolvido, riscado da lista.

items.q: "I'm about **halfway** through." Halfway means…
items.why: Halfway = na metade.

items.q: "How's it **going**?" How's it going asks…
items.why: How's it going = como está indo.

items.q: "Let me **keep you posted**." To keep someone posted means to…
items.why: Keep posted = manter informado.

items.q: "I'll get **straight to** the facts." To get straight to something means to…
items.why: Straight to = direto ao ponto.
